records.notes: JRA A+ capability and A+ public ceiling are approved. Individual meetings remain limited to reviewed canonical fields and human-approved publication.

NAR and local-government racing have an approved A+ system ceiling. NAR monthly convene info remains the national mother-set source and is unioned with independent regional/operator official positive evidence.

South Kanto 4 Racing official quarterly calendar (nankankeiba.com/calendar/YYYYQQ.do with quarter-start months 01/04/07/10) is an independent mother_set source for Urawa, Funabashi, Oi, and Kawasaki. Positive evidence is unioned with NAR; source failure must block absence-based public removal.

Iwate Keiba official monthly calendar is an independent mother_set source for Morioka and Mizusawa. Venue blocks are identified by the official Morioka/Mizusawa calendar markers and their bounded date rows. Positive evidence is unioned with NAR; absence removal requires both NAR monthly convene info and this source to be complete.
Banei Tokachi has an approved A+ system ceiling. Banei terminology and field interpretation remain separate from flat-racing assumptions.
